title: Goroutines, Channels, Context, and a Tracker
summary: Combine goroutines, channels, synchronization, context cancellation, JSON, files, and tests in a race-safe persistent tracker.

sections.heading: Core model
sections.content: A goroutine runs concurrently and must have a defined completion and cancellation path. Channels communicate typed values and can coordinate ownership, but they are not required for every shared value. Only a sender should close a channel, and closing signals that no more values will arrive. Protect shared mutable state with confinement or synchronization and run tests with `go test -race`. `context.Context` carries cancellation and deadlines across call boundaries; pass it explicitly and do not store it in a struct. Validate decoded JSON before replacing trusted state and write files through a controlled boundary.
